name: Miwa Tomoe
source:
Part of unit drop

Always carrying around a stuffed dog, he has a brutally honest and masculine personality despite his feminine exterior.
He is always being watched over by Miake Sawa and Tenjin Haruto, who all met at the same orphanage.
